say:3:1621315002:1.text: Well, you're always changing your appearance through transfiguration. Today you're a rugged warrior, tomorrow you might be a mysterious witch, or even a hamster.

say:4:1621315003:0.text: Even I'm not entirely sure what you really look like, let alone those artists who have never seen you. This painting is the most popular version now, so I got a copy for my collection...
say:4:1621315003:0.source_cn: 连我都不确定您真实的模样是什么，更不用说世间其他没见过...

say:5:1621315004:2.text: I'm sure this portrait can do the trick. Just trust me, Magister.
